pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 24085-24092 (label lemma-local-cohomology-closed, canonical tag 0953): for a ring R and a finitely generated ideal I, the subcategory of I-power torsion modules depends only on the closed subset V(I) of Spec(R), and a module is I-power torsion exactly when its support is contained in V(I). The proof environment at source lines 24094-24104 immediately follows it and is its own proof: it argues elementwise that annihilation by a power of I is equivalent to vanishing in the localizations at all primes outside V(I), using the finite generation of I to lift vanishing to the localizations at the generators, and then identifies the power torsion submodule with the kernel of the map into the product of those localizations.
